📊 *weekly triage digest* — 2026-08-19 → 2026-08-26

*Volume:* 33 alerts triaged · 8 posted · 24 suppressed to digest (+1 false-alarm closed out separately — not posted, not part of the deferred pile)
⚠ 2026-08-21 → 2026-08-25 (5 days) have zero recorded poll-cycles, not just missing actionable files. Root cause confirmed via the 13:05Z health-status DM: laptop hit Critical Battery Trigger and entered Modern Standby at 2026-08-21 06:17 ET, didn't resume until lid-open at 2026-08-26 08:58 ET (~5d17h asleep; distinct mechanism from the 07-23 reboot gap). This also silently skipped the scheduled 2026-08-24 weekly-digest run — no digest posted for the 08-17→08-24 window. Everything below is built from just the 08-19/08-20 data; read WoW deltas as gap-distorted, not a real trend.

*Top recurrences this week* (ranked by occurrence; all from the 2 non-gap days)
| occ | Δ vs last wk | entry | fix_status |
|-----|--------------|-------|------------|
| 14 | -23 | `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout` | chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05 |

| 1 | +1 (was 0) | `ki-2026-08-14-nonprod-apps-redis-crossslot-cacheflush` | needs-human |

*New this week:* none — no KB entry has `first_seen` inside the window.

*Aging:* 7 of the 8 entries above are ≥30d since their `fix_status` field last changed (tracked via git-blame on that field, not first_seen — a tighter floor than prior digests used, which fell back to first_seen). Oldest: `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` — still `investigating` at 94d / 267 occurrences. Only `ki-2026-08-14-nonprod-apps-redis-crossslot-cacheflush` is recent (12d).

*Concentration:* top 3 = 21/27 = 77.8% of this week's occurrences — above Method's ~66% all-time standing figure, but n=27 drawn from a 2-day sample; not a reliable read on a real concentration shift this week.

*Suppression:* 24 suppressed vs 8 posted (75%) — roughly in line with the last confirmed week (63%, 08-10→08-17); gate still functioning, not trending toward over-suppression, though the small sample limits confidence.

One thing worth doing next week: `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` has sat at `investigating` for 94 days across 267 occurrences — the longest-unmoved status in the active pile.
